verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a cloud database platform that ships a CLI and agent tooling, but nothing in the evidence documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out for the CLI, console, MCP server or platform. The AI-use page covers what data the SQL Editor AI features share (schema only, no data). That is a related privacy disclosure, not an opt-out control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
